route./.desc: Forkcast is the ultimate meal planning app that helps you organize your weekly meals, discover new recipes, and cook stress free. With our intuitive interface and powerful features, you can easily create meal plans, generate shopping lists, and explore a wide variety of recipes tailored to your preferences.
route./auth/forgot.desc: Reset your password if you have forgotten it.
route./auth/login.desc: Log in to access your meal plans and recipes.
route./auth/signup.desc: Create an account to start planning your meals.
route./dashboard.desc: View your meal plans, discover new recipes, and manage your account settings.
route./dashboard/account.desc: View and edit your account information, including your username, email, and password.
route./dashboard/schedule.desc: View and manage your meal plans for the week. Add new meals, edit existing ones, and organize your schedule.
route./dashboard/settings.desc: Customize your experience by adjusting your preferences, notification settings, and other options.
route./about.desc: Learn more about Forkcast, our mission, and the team behind the app.
route./contact.desc: Get in touch with us for support, feedback, or any inquiries you may have.
route./cookie-policy.desc: Learn about our use of cookies and how we protect your privacy.
route./documentation.desc: Access our comprehensive documentation to learn how to use Forkcast effectively.
route./faq.desc: Find answers to frequently asked questions about Forkcast.
route./manual.desc: Step-by-step guide to help you get started with Forkcast.
route./privacy-policy.desc: Learn about how we collect, use, and protect your personal information.
route./source.desc: Explore the source code of Forkcast on our GitHub repository.
route./terms-of-use.desc: Read the terms of use for Forkcast to understand your rights and responsibilities when using our app.
privacy-policy.introduction.text: This website, “Forkcast”, is a school project developed by Forkcast Solutions at HTL Leonding, Upper Austria. The website is provided free of charge and can be used by anyone. As this is a work in progress, no guarantees regarding availability, accuracy, or functionality are given.
privacy-policy.data_collection.text: We collect and store user data strictly for functional purposes of the website. This includes:
privacy-policy.data_collection.payment_n: No payment data is collected or processed at any time.
privacy-policy.purpose.text: The collected data is used solely to:
privacy-policy.purpose.list.planner: Enable the meal planner and recipe features
privacy-policy.purpose.list.security: Ensure basic operation and security of the website
privacy-policy.storage.text: All data is stored in a database. Appropriate technical measures are taken to protect the data within the scope of this school project. However, as this is a non-commercial project, no guarantees regarding data security can be provided.
privacy-policy.rights.text: Users may modify or delete their data themselves if such functionality is available on the website. If this functionality is not yet implemented, users may request changes or deletion of their data by contacting the team via email. Requests will be processed as soon as possible.
privacy-policy.sharing.text: No personal data is sold or shared with third parties, unless required by applicable law.
privacy-policy.cookies.text: Currently, no cookies or tracking technologies are actively used. Such technologies may be implemented in future versions of the website to improve functionality.
privacy-policy.liability.text: Forkcast is a school project and is provided without any warranties or legal guarantees. The team does not take responsibility for any issues arising from the use of the website, including but not limited to data loss or service interruptions.
privacy-policy.changes.text: This privacy policy may be updated at any time without prior notice, as the website is under continuous development.
privacy-policy.contact.text: For any questions, or to request data modification or deletion, please contact:
